title: Main / Reviewer
scope: Global architecture, cross-lane review, consolidation, roadmap/state authority and hardening, including target inference profile balance and shared-contract compatibility.
next_action: Review raw worker lanes in REVIEW_REQUIRED, reconcile projection drift, and preserve downstream physical gates.

completed_work.summary: Canonical chat registry, generated lane bootstraps, claim-bound review packets, submit-review transition and validation/tests merged.
Recovered historical chat-only work into canonical roadmaps/workstreams, added deletion-safe archive policy and backlog visibility.
Continuous checkpoints now persist safe resume state throughout work and final review handoff.
Added autonomous checkpoint freshness watchdog to canonical projection.
Registered bounded Cantiere automation pilot and deletion-safe replacement of Cantiere 2.6.
Reviewer intake no longer depends on a possibly stale projection; explicit accept/rework transitions and atomic handoff rules are operational.

checkpoints.summary: Continuous autonomous chat checkpointing implemented, validated and merged via PR #85.
decisions: Do not depend on detecting native chat context exhaustion.
Persist material progress event-by-event during work.
Replacement chats resume from canonical state plus last_checkpoint.
checkpoints.next_action: Use continuous checkpoints automatically in every claimed lane; user intervention is not required for normal chat rollover.

checkpoints.summary: Checkpoint freshness watchdog implemented, tested and merged via PR #86.
decisions: Warn after 120 minutes without a current-claim checkpoint.
Surface to Main/Reviewer instead of fabricating content.
Do not auto-block before normal claim lease expiry.
checkpoints.next_action: Use projection.checkpoint_watch to detect lanes that may be working without recently persisted resume state.

checkpoints.summary: First bounded autonomous chat pilot registered for Cantiere and old Cantiere 2.6 promoted to deletion candidate via PR #87.
decisions: One bounded Cantiere work item per cycle.
Stop at Main/Reviewer or physical-owner gates.
checkpoints.next_action: Observe first Cantiere Auto-Pilot cycles and compare canonical checkpoints/results before enabling additional chat lanes.

checkpoints.summary: Reviewer pipeline repaired. PR #88 merged, raw workstreams are now authoritative for reviewer intake, review-accept/review-rework transitions exist, and the Cantiere #745 malformed handoff was repaired and reviewed without claiming physical acceptance.
decisions: Reviewer must scan raw workstream files, not projection.review_required alone.
Cantiere #745 implementation is approved; Phase 1 ONLINE remains open for physical Manga Kids retest.
checkpoints.next_action: Let the automatic Main/Reviewer scan raw lanes on each cycle; Cantiere next gate is a bounded physical Manga Kids retest on a release containing #745.
